info.cls_ename: Master Program of Space System Engineering

description.describe_ch: 課程中將介紹專題之整理、分析以及表達方法之基礎、操作原理、研究生專題演講訓練、專題報告撰寫整理及分析。
description.describe_eh: The course contains introduction of composition, analysis and representation with special research topics and operating principles of the seminar, training of a talk representation with special topics of the graduate student, training to writing and analysis of the special topics work.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生獨立進行科學研究的能力，並將其應用於太空領域的問題。
targets.describe_en: Develop students' ability to conduct independent scientific research and apply it to problems in the field of space studies.

targets.describe_ch: 強化學生在文獻回顧、研究設計、數據收集和分析等方面的專業技能。
targets.describe_en: Enhance students' professional skills in literature review, research design, data collection, and analysis.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生批判性思維和問題解決能力，以提出創新的研究問題和方法。
targets.describe_en: Foster students' critical thinking and problem-solving abilities to propose innovative research questions and approaches.

targets.describe_ch: 鼓勵學生在研究過程中培養團隊合作和溝通能力。
targets.describe_en: Encourage teamwork and communication skills among students during the research process.

targets.describe_ch: 強化學生在撰寫學術論文和口頭報告方面的能力。
targets.describe_en: Strengthen students' ability to write scholarly papers and deliver oral presentations.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生遵守學術倫理和專業標準的意識。
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students' awareness of academic ethics and professional standards.
